fallback_history.trigger: new immutable history file creation blocked by connector safety/write guard
fallback_history.append_rule: Fetch current ledger and blob SHA; append exactly one compact JSON line to the exact prior bytes; entry must include previous_ledger_blob_sha equal to fetched ledger blob SHA; update_file with that fresh SHA; re-fetch; verify old content is exact prefix and RUN_ID occurs exactly once in the appended suffix.
fallback_history.completed_run_rule: A completed run may use ledger fallback only when the ledger entry contains the exact complete finalized payload and the re-fetched ledger is verified. latest/state/manifest may then advance and must record history_mode=ledger_fallback and ledger_blob_sha.
fallback_history.partial_run_rule: If the complete finalized payload is unavailable, append only a truthful partial/failure receipt and do not advance latest/state/manifest.
